name: surveillance:servant
source:
A game about hypnosis, fragile self-image, and revealing too much.  

“All you need to do is follow my instructions. Do you understand?”

After being called out and excommunicated from her social media circles, avid fangirl Lila struggles to cope with the aftermath. With her feelings of depression and isolation increasing by the day, her ability to function continues to decline. However, when a comforting DM arrives from an internet stranger in her inbox, Lila gets introduced to a whole new method of rest and relaxation... But what this stranger brings into Lila’s life may be more than anything she could have ever imagined.

[From [url=https://nooroodle.itch.io/surveillanceservant]itch.io[/url]]
